thesis: Mahamoti Djinn was blue control's classic finisher because a single large flyer could end the game while the rest of the deck devoted itself to cards and permission.

playbook.role: Wait until the opponent's hand and board are controlled, then deploy the Djinn with protection available. Its job is to close, not to rescue a position already lost to multiple threats.
